title: Capability
description: One row in the operator-portal capability catalog. The minter, the verifier, the portal, and the customer-facing documentation all read this same record. Edit one file; the renders regenerate.

key.description: Machine-readable capability identifier. Lowercase, hyphen-separated. This is the string that lands in the token caps[] claim and the string the gate checks. Once a key ships, it cannot be renamed without an API break.

displayName.description: The checkbox label the operator sees in the portal. 3-6 words; no jargon. Reads as a thing the customer can do, not as a feature name.

summary.description: One-line answer to 'what does turning this on let the customer do?'. Used in the catalog index and the preview pane. Plain English; no Herald-internal vocabulary.

tooltip.description: The 30-60 word body the portal shows on hover. Practical 'what this means for me' framing for non-technical IT staff. May include a short analogy when the underlying concept is technical (audit chain, multi-tenant routing). Markdown allowed but kept light — bold and inline code only.

category.description: The portal grouping. Picked from a fixed list so the catalog renders as a consistent set of sections.

tier.description: The SKU this capability normally ships with. Used in the portal copy ('this is normally a Pro feature') and in the public docs. A capability can be added to any token via the caps[] override regardless of tier; this field describes the default home.

status.description: active = available in the catalog; deprecated = grandfathered, hidden from new mints; sentinel = not a customer-facing feature (e.g. demo-watermark — present for runtime side-effects only).

deprecatedSince.description: Set when status is deprecated. The portal renders the row strikethrough with this date.

replacedBy.description: Set when a deprecated capability has a successor. Value is the successor's key.

relatedCapabilities.description: Capability keys that pair with this one. Used by the portal to render 'turning this on also enables...' links and by the catalog renderer to build cross-references in the prose explainer.

implies.description: Capability keys that are auto-granted when this one is granted. The verifier expands implies[] transitively. Used to model dependencies (e.g. ffiec-chain implies compliance-overlay) so the minter doesn't have to list both.

operatorNote.description: Optional extra context the portal can surface in a 'learn more' drawer. Use when the tooltip can't carry the full story (regulatory framing, billing notes, segment-specific quirks).

since.description: First version of MMP.Licensing.Contracts that shipped this capability. Renderer-only; never affects gate behavior.
